request.description: Offers a lead to a chosen CA, bypassing the rules (strategy `manual`, default SLA). The CA must be verified, active and unpaused, and the person must allow sharing with that CA (403 `CONSENT_REQUIRED`). Refused with 409 while another offer is active; revoke it first. Staff only, lead update access (ops lead, ops reviewer).
